jobs.desc:
Req ID 90660 | M&L Chennai, India, ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited

 Job Description

 About the team: 
ZF's Commercial Vehicle Solutions (CVS) division helps shaping the future of commercial transportation ecosystems. Our mission is to be the preferred global technology partner for the commercial vehicle industry. CVS Division is supported by approximately 25,000 employees working at 61 locations in 28 countries.

 What you can look forward to as Assistant Manager - Manufacturing engineering (Tool Design) (m/f/d): 

• Design of attribute, variable, and combined gauges for incoming and in-process inspection.

• Design of machining and assembly fixtures, supporting both new product development and existing product capacity enhancement.

• Design and development of automation solutions for part loading, unloading, and process automation.

• Design of end-of-line test rigs for component performance verification.

• Design of assembly stations and special-purpose machines, focusing on ease of assembly and efficiency.

• Re-engineer fixture and gauge designs to improve quality and productivity.

 Your Profile as Assistant Manager - Manufacturing engineering (Tool Design) (m/f/d): 

• Educational Qualification: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with a Diploma/Post-Diploma/PG-Diploma in Tool Design, Machine Design, or Tool Engineering.

• Experience: 5–8 years of relevant experience in fixture and gauge design, manufacturing, and automation.

• Concept Design: Strong conceptual design skills and proficiency in interpreting component drawings.

• Manufacturing Processes: Sound understanding of various manufacturing processes and material selection.

• Mechanical & Pneumatic Knowledge: Familiarity with standard mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components used in fixtures and Special Purpose Machines (SPMs).

• Fixture & Gauge Design: Strong knowledge of jigs, fixtures, and gauge design principles.

 Why you should choose ZF in India: 

• Innovative Environment: ZF is at the forefront of technological advancements, offering a dynamic and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and growth.

• Diverse and Inclusive Culture: ZF fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees are valued and respected, promoting a culture of collaboration and mutual support.

• Career Development: ZF is committed to the professional growth of its employees, offering extensive training programs, career development opportunities, and a clear path for advancement.

• Global Presence: As a part of a global leader in driveline and chassis technology, ZF provides opportunities to work on international projects and collaborate with teams worldwide.

• Sustainability Focus: ZF is dedicated to sustainability and environmental responsibility, actively working towards creating eco-friendly solutions and reducing its carbon footprint.

• Employee Well-being: ZF prioritizes the well-being of its employees, providing comprehensive health and wellness programs, flexible work arrangements, and a supportive work-life balance.

 Be part of our ZF team as Assistant Manager - Manufacturing Engineering (Tool design) and apply now!

 Contact

 Chella Parvathi Subramanian

jobs.title: Tooling specialist (Press tools)
jobs.desc:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

 This Position reports to:
Production Engineering Manager 

 What we believe in 

 At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

 Your role and responsibilities 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to Optimizes the Production organization's assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety.
 The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

 As a Tooling Specialist, you will support for ABB India – Electrification, Smart Power Business to be based at Nelamangala – Bangalore.

 You will be mainly accountable for: 

 • Material & Process Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of ferrous, non-ferrous, and insulation materials, with practical experience in sheet-metal and non-ferrous stamping, hot/cold forging, machining, assemblies, heat treatment, and surface treatment processes.

• Tooling & Manufacturing Development: Oversee development and validation of press tools, molds, gauges, fixtures, and sub-assemblies; review DFM and ensure tooling meets required standards for precision, durability, quality, and manufacturability.

• Supplier Development & Localization: Identify and develop suitable Indian suppliers, lead part localization based on engineering drawings and specifications, and coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely development and regular supply of critical parts.

• Quality & Engineering Validation: Conduct PPAP, joint inspections, sampling inspections, tooling trials, and dimensional/process validation; collaborate with Global/US Engineering and Quality teams to validate critical components and close technical issues.

• Project, Cost & Stakeholder Management: Manage cost-saving initiatives, monitor project milestones and development timelines, provide biweekly management updates, and ensure effective execution of supplier development projects within defined cost, quality, and delivery targets. Exposure to Low Voltage Electrical Switchgear and plastic mold development.

 Qualifications for the role: 

 • Educational Qualification: Diploma in Tool & Die Making from reputed institutions such as NTTF, GTTC, CTTC, or equivalent tooling institutes; alternatively, a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with relevant experience.

• Relevant Experience: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in press tool development, sheet metal component development, and tooling-related activities.

• Engineering Drawing Skills: Solid ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering drawings, specifications, and technical requirements.

• CAD & Modelling Skills: Practical experience in 3D solid modelling and AutoCAD, with the ability to support tooling and component development activities.

• Communication Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively coordinate with suppliers, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.

• Global Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with US and international teams across different time zones, while demonstrating effective teamwork and collaboration skills.

• Travel & Teamwork: Willingness to travel extensively across India and visit supplier locations to support tooling and component development, resolve issues, and ensure timely project completion; should work well with others.

 More about us 

 ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

 ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

 Design Engineer - Body Structures (BIW)

 Responsible for designing and developing Body in White (BIW) components that meet performance, cost, and manufacturing goals. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, production-ready solutions with a focus on structural integrity, efficiency, and compliance.

jobs.title: Industrialization Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

 Could you be the full-time Industrialization Engineer in Badli Depot (Delhi, India) we’re looking for?
 our future role 

 Take on a new challenge and apply your industrialization and maintenance expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside passionate and collaborative teammates.

 You'll play a key role in supporting industrial activities as part of the DMRC L2 Project, ensuring the implementation and optimization of preventive and overhaul maintenance activities. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (including Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Sourcing), support the design and maintenance of industrial equipment, and much more.

 You’ll specifically take care of assessing preventive and overhaul activities, as well as ensuring adherence to work instructions, but also support the creation of task lists, sequencing, and method execution.

 We’ll look to you for:

• 
 Assessing preventive and overhaul activities alongside DMRC/Alstom staff

• 
 Supporting the implementation of industrial work instructions

• 
 Identifying and addressing gaps between documented work instructions and actual activities

• 
 Verifying the list of parts for maintenance, including local technical information and supplier requirements

• 
 Providing input into the design of material handling equipment (MHE) and specific tooling equipment

• 
 Ensuring the maintenance of industrial equipment

• 
 Managing the maintenance and control of active tools on-site and at subcontractors

• 
 Supporting procurement activities such as e-buy creation, PR generation, and supplier follow-up

• 
 Maintaining traceability and audit documentation

• 
 Participating in inspections and self-checks

• 
 Implementing standard operating procedures and work instructions

 All about you 

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

• 
 Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering

• 
 Strong hands-on experience in preventive and overhaul maintenance processes

• 
 Experience with rolling stock maintenance (minimum 5 years)

• 
 Knowledge of GSI/SAP systems

• 
 Familiarity with CAD, 3D tools, SAP, and Maximo

• 
 Ability to read, write, and speak English fluently

• 
 Autonomous, rigorous, and equipped with strong communication skills

• 
 Innovative mindset and participative approach in business workgroups

 Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

• 
 Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines

• 
 Work with new security standards for rail signalling

• 
 Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

• 
 Contribute to innovative projects

• 
 Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment

• 
 Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

• 
 Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

• 
 Progress towards roles such as Industrial Manager or other leadership positions

• 
 Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
 Important to note 

 As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

 Job Description: 
 Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.  We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

 Role Definition: 
 Designs, develops, builds, and implements new components, products, or technologies. 

 Responsibilities
 • Creating new component level designs and resolves issues regarding the manufacturing or product operation. Ensuring design acceptance, manufacturing readiness, and validation.
• Participating in the adoption of new technologies and process improvements to achieve greater efficiency, cost reduction and quality improvement.
• Support definition of engineering procedures to make the product or process more reliable, efficient and cost-effective. Understanding functional requirements and translating into detail design documents.
• Collaborating with all functional areas to provide a design solution that meets the requirements of the enterprise partners and customers.
• Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum.

 Education requirements:
 • B.E. / B. Tech.  in Mechanical engineering (or equivalent) from an accredited engineering college with 3+ years of product development experience
• M.E. / M. Tech in Mechanical engineering (or equivalent) from an accredited engineering college with 2+ years of product development experience

 Mandatory requirements are: 
 • Strong in first principle thinking
• Clarity of thought and good communication skills – should be able to explain & present his/her ideas 
• Experienced/conversant with fundamentals of structural design concepts: Stress/Strain, beam/shell theory, pressure vessel calculations, high/low cycle fatigue theories etc. 
• Ability to perform hand calculation verifications with sound mechanical design fundamentals.  
• Minimum 5 years experience in design of gas turbine external systems (i.e., secondary cooling system, lube oil system, bleed air systems, fuel systems, etc.) 
• Ability to evaluate gas turbine external systems to prove they meet manufacturing, assembly, durability and functional requirements. 
• Familiarity with conventional gas turbine components / systems, functionality as well as its manufacturing and assembly processes. 
• Experience collaborating on cross-functional design teams, presenting on design reviews and documenting design per NPI (New Product Introduction) tollgate process. 
• Basic Creo / NX modeling capabilities (defeature / modify 3D models) . 
• Ability interpreting and defining assembly / manufacturing drawings following Geometrical Tolerancing standards. Experience reviewing / approving drawings and Bill of Materials.  

 Preferred requirements are: 
 • 10 years design experience of gas turbine external systems (i.e., secondary cooling system, lube oil system, bleed air systems, fuel systems, etc.)
• Expertise in gas turbine external systems manufacturing, assembly processes and field issues resolution.
• Exposure to gas turbine field serviceability (tooling and processes) and transportability (shipping, lifting, tooling, weight management, etc.)
• Knowledgeable on gas turbine systems operability (start system, lube oil system, control system, etc.)
• 5 years experience in design and FEA structural analysis of components / systems. (i.e., stress, deflection, modal, harmonic, elastic-plastic material properties, transients, contacts, etc.)
• Exposure to development engine testing (defining instrumentation, supporting engine build and testing)
• “Cradle to grave” component ownership of gas turbine components
• FMEA, Risk Assessment and failure analysis expertise

jobs.title: Lead Process Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

 Could you be the full-time Lead Process Engineer in Bangalore we’re looking for?
 NY      Your future role 

 Take on a new challenge and apply your process engineering expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside a dedicated and innovative team of professionals.

 You'll play a pivotal role in driving industrial excellence and supporting the delivery of world-class mobility solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as Product Development, Production, and Quality Assurance), define and deploy industrialization standards and methodologies, and much more.

 You’ll specifically take care of managing and developing your team’s skills and ensuring the successful industrialization of projects, but also support production activities and ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.

 We’ll look to you for:

• 
 Defining and updating function procedures, ways of working, and methodologies, aligned with central PME guidelines

• 
 Ensuring team staffing aligns with project workloads

• 
 Building induction and training programs for newcomers

• 
 Maintaining the team’s skills matrix and developing annual training plans

• 
 Deploying industrialization standards, methodologies, and IS tools (e.g., PLM, ERP, MES)

• 
 Increasing the maturity of the team using the APSYS roadmap

• 
 Supporting product/project industrialization activities and ensuring deliverables are accurate and of high quality

• 
 Ensuring adherence to EHS, ergonomics, and special process requirements

• 
 Providing production support, including for first articles manufacturing and onsite/offshore activities

 All about you 

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

• 
 Technical education background

• 
 Fluency in English (read, written, spoken)

• 
 8 to 10 years of experience, preferably in the railway, automobile, or aerospace industries

• 
 Technical expertise in process engineering, manufacturing work instructions, line balancing, Lean Manufacturing, and BOM creation

• 
 Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) for Bill of Materials, routings, and configuration follow-up

• 
 Knowledge of CAD and PLM tools (e.g., CATIA, DELMIA)

• 
 Familiarity with quality standards, EHS, ergonomics, and process methodologies like Process FMEA, QRQC, and 8D

• 
 Strong leadership, team collaboration, and communication skills

• 
 A commitment to conscientiousness and delivering on promises

 Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

• 
 Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from repetitive routines

• 
 Work with new security standards for rail signalling

• 
 Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues

• 
 Contribute to innovative projects shaping the future of mobility

• 
 Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment

• 
 Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

• 
 Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning opportunities

• 
 Progress towards senior leadership roles

• 
 Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

 Important to note 

 As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Tooling/Controls, Satellites (Starlink)
jobs.desc:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 As a member of the Starlink satellite mechanical team you will stand up the in-house, high-rate manufacturing tooling used to make custom optical fiber connections for Starlink. You will get to own the whole production system: establish requirements, processes, and design custom machinery to enable high-rate production. Using your expertise in mechanical design and machine controls, you will implement, simplify, and automate high-reliability manufacturing processes to scale production for a variety of Starlink vehicles. Your tooling will be used by different teams at Starlink spanning from operator-assisted stations to automated cells, and will build mission-critical hardware that is pivotal to the success of our next generation satellites. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES :

• Stand up internal high-rate optical fiber harness termination for Starlink, taking the process from development equipment to production-capable machinery

• Design and develop tooling, fixtures, mechanisms, and automation equipment to terminate, assemble, and test flight hardware at rate

• Own the electromechanical stack on the equipment you design: structure, motion, sensors, actuators, and machine controls, from concept through commissioning

• Own projects through their full lifecycle — concept, fabrication, controls bring-up, and production introduction

• Partner with flight harness responsible engineers, quality, and production to develop process and equipment in parallel with the product

• Solve complex problems around precision alignment, process repeatability, cycle time, and first-pass yield

• Assemble, wire, program, debug, and commission the equipment you design on the production floor

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS :

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, mechatronics, electrical, manufacturing, or a related engineering/STEM discipline

• 1+ years of experience designing mechanical systems using 3D CAD software and 2D drawings (internships, co-ops, and university projects can apply)

• 1+ years of experience implementing controls on mechanical systems - motion, sensors, actuators, PLC or equivalent (internships, co-ops, and university project can apply)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE :

• 3+ years of experience in custom machine design, production tooling, or automated assembly equipment

• Experience with electromechanical systems: motors, actuators, linear rails, bearings, pneumatics, sensors, and precision locating features

• Hands-on experience with machine controls: PLC or industrial motion controllers, servo/stepper systems, I/O, safety circuits, and HMI

• Familiarity with precision assembly processes — fiber optics, cable/harness build, potting/curing, or similarly tight-tolerance joining and inspection

• Ability to perform structures and mechanism hand calculations; design for manufacturability and assembly

• Familiarity with drafting standards and GD&T

• Solid understanding of common manufacturing processes (mills, lathes, CNC, sheet metal, welding) and hands-on build experience

• Experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter, or equivalent CAD/PDM systems

• Experience with manufacturing process development, PFMEA, and error-proofing

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

• Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to support mission critical deadlines 

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: 

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $135,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $165,000.00

 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

 Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX.  ALTEN Sud-Ouest, acteur clé de l’ingénierie aéronautique, recherche un Chef de Projet Conception Outillage pour renforcer son équipe dédiée aux Jigs & Tools (outillages de production et d’assemblage). • Intégrer les nouvelles technologies (simulation 3D, fabrication additive, automatisation) pour moderniser les outillages.

• Former et accompagner les équipes de production à l’utilisation des nouveaux outillages.

• Connaissance des logiciels de CAO (CATIA V5/V6, NX, SolidWorks) et des méthodes de fabrication (usinage, composite, métrologie).

 • Expertise technique : maîtrise des contraintes de conception d’outillages (tolérances, matériaux, ergonomie).

• Leadership et communication : aptitude à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs techniques et managériaux.
• Rigueur et analyse : sens du détail pour garantir la précision et la fiabilité des outillages.
• Maîtrise de l’anglais technique (niveau professionnel).

 Rejoindre ALTEN, c’est intégrer une entreprise qui place le développement de carrière de ses ingénieurs au cœur de son modèle. Vous bénéficierez rapidement de responsabilités et d’opportunités d’évolution en phase avec vos objectifs professionnels. ALTEN vous offre un environnement stimulant et innovant, où vous pourrez travailler sur des projets ambitieux et de grande envergure, notamment dans le secteur aéronautique. Si l'idée de contribuer à des projets à la fois passionnants et internationaux vous motive, tout en développant vos compétences dans un cadre collaboratif et valorisant, alors rencontrons nous !
 ALTEN, Entreprise Handi-accueillante.

jobs.title: Tooling Specialist - Metrology
jobs.desc:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems. 

 At Alstom , the Metrology function plays a critical role in ensuring the dimensional accuracy, quality, and reliability of manufacturing tooling, including jigs, fixtures, gauges, and assembly tools. This position supports production excellence by verifying compliance with engineering specifications, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) requirements, and quality standards. The Metrology team contributes directly to product safety, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. 

 More Than a Job: A Mission 

 We seek a passionate Tooling Specialist - Metrology to drive precision and innovation in rail manufacturing. Join dedicated teams committed to delivering robust solutions that ensure safety and reliability for communities. As a professional and team manager, you will own complex projects and shape the legacy of mobility. 

 Your Role, Your Impact 

• Design and implement scalable metrology solutions to optimize production processes and support large-scale rail projects. 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including manufacturing, quality, and engineering, to ensure seamless integration of tooling systems. 

• Maintain and improve reliability of measurement systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards and minimizing downtime. 

• Drive innovation by evaluating and adopting new metrology technologies and methodologies to enhance operational efficiency. 

• Share knowledge and best practices with team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence. 

 You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility, ensuring seamless integration of business and technology. 

 What You Bring 

• Experience in tooling engineering or metrology within a manufacturing environment. 

• Proficiency in CAD software, measurement systems, and statistical analysis tools - knowledge of PolyWorks is mandatory. 

• Practical experience with Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) is required. 

• Strong understanding of precision engineering, quality assurance, and process optimization. 

• Excellent communication, problem-solving, and leadership skills; ability to manage projects and mentor junior engineers. 

 How Success Is Measured 

• Consistent achievement of project delivery timelines and strategic goals. 

• Effective collaboration and leadership within multidisciplinary teams. 

• Reduction in defects, improved troubleshooting, and increased operational efficiency. 

 Alstom, A Great Place to Grow 

• Work with advanced metrology technologies and contribute to Alstom’s strategic vision for rail innovation. 

• Make a global impact from our Plattsburgh office, connecting communities and shaping sustainable mobility. 

• Advance your career through continuous learning, training, and development opportunities. 

 Salary Range 

 In accordance with New York State law, the anticipated salary range for this position is 65,000 - 85,000 USD . The actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, education, and qualifications. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include bonuses, incentive pay, or other forms of compensation.   

 Join a team where precision, innovation, and quality drive the future of sustainable transportation. 

 Here, progress isn't always easy but the impact is real. Because the scale is massive, the tasks are complex when the system runs, the train moves, and the city connects that feeling stays with you. And the legacy lasts.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. 

 Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector has an opening for a Tool Design Engineer – Level 3 or Level 4 to join our Mission Enabling Products MEP Team. This position will be located in San Diego, California .

 This position can be filled at a level 3 or level 4. 

 Northrop Grumman Mission Enabling Products (MEP) Business Unit designs, builds, and delivers space, defense and aviation-related systems to customers around the world. Our main products include satellites and associated space components and services, launch vehicles and related propulsion systems, missile products, subsystems and defense electronics, precision weapons, armament systems, and advanced aerospace structures.

 Learn more about Mission Enabling Products at our website: https://www.northropgrumman.com/space/spacecraft-components/ 

 As a Tool Design Engineer, you will develop and design complex composite manufacturing and test tooling. You will collaborate with Manufacturing, Test, and other Engineering functions to ensure successful execution and delivery of hardware.

 Job responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: 
 • Create, prototype, design, and analyze tools and fixtures for manufacturing and testing of composite parts and assemblies. Tools include layup molds, precision assembly fixtures, Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and test fixtures

• Develop and refine components and subsystems utilizing design skills, hand calculations, CAD modeling software and analytical tools

• Perform detailed 3D designs and generate 2D engineering drawings

• Participate and present in internal and external (customer) design reviews. Includes generation of presentation media for PDR, CDR, and MRR type reviews

• Support manufacturing and test of fixtures and hardware as required

• Aid in the generation of manufacturing and test plans

• Support procurement of hardware and tooling

• Manage and track multiple priorities while maintaining a focus towards common project goals of the program team, matrix organization, and customers

• Support continuous improvement of departmental tools and procedures

• Ensure designs meet manufacturing and test plans, while maintaining targets for cost and schedule

 Basic Qualifications for Level 3: 
 • Bachelors of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering with five (5) years working in a structural design field

• Aerospace experience with product definition and design. Understanding of specifications, SOW's, drawings, ICD compliance

• Understanding of aerospace materials and assembly methods (bonding/fastening)

• Ability to perform design of complex, multi-piece tool assemblies to ensure successful execution of manufacturing and test plans

• Experience in CAD and PLM systems, such as Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

• Experience in drawing generation, with practical knowledge and use of GD&T

• Experience with Design for Manufacturability (DFMA) principles and mistake-proofing techniques

• Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government clearance

 Basic Qualifications for Level 4:

jobs.desc:
About Us 

 At CNH, we're driven by a clear purpose: we serve and advance the people who feed and build a growing world. 

 As a global leader in agriculture and construction, we create the equipment, technology, and solutions that help our customers work more productively and sustainably. Our success starts with our people, and we foster a collaborative culture where innovation thrives and every employee has the opportunity to grow.

 Grow a Career. Build a Future. 

 If you're ready to make an impact and build a career with purpose, there's a place for you at CNH.

 Job Purpose 

 Construct, alter and repair a variety of special tools, templates, fixtures and weld jigs. They create customer success by delivering the best experiences to their internal and external customers.

 Key Responsibilities 

• Follow prescribed safety standards, rules and regulations including those regarding the usage of PPE, Emergency Plans and EH&S Policy.

• To identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions by completing observation cards.

• To maintain 5s by removing all tools, equipment, and parts not needed in the work area and for those that are needed to ensure they have a dedicated, labeled home and are in that dedicated home. 

• To monitor for and alert their Team Leader or Supervisor of any abnormalities from the standards in their area. This includes abnormalities in standard processes, standard machine operation, product quality, and logistics management.

• Completes all CILR activities as required, identifies deficiencies and sources of contamination, including difficult access areas in the workstation, and provides suitable countermeasures to address these issues.

• Construct, alter and repair a variety of special tools and templates, fixtures, and weld jigs. 

• To fabricate parts to specifications using various manual fabrication machines such as saws, brakes, lathes, and mills.

• Check tooling made or modified by outside subcontractors to insure it meets quality specifications.

• Bench work involving filing, grinding, assembling, and adjusting to obtain satisfactory operations.

• Perform welding requiring skill and knowledge of fabricating practices when the need arises.

• Responsible for cost reductions as applicable to the area. 

• Move materials as necessary in the performance of duties. 

• Ensure all products meet the quality guidelines and follow all quality standards, procedures and guidelines in place and be active in improving product quality.

• To be involved in the root cause analysis of S EWO, EWO, HERCA, and equipment problems.

• To contribute to the continuous improvement of safety, quality, and productivity by submitting one (1) Suggestion every two (2) months for a total of six (6) per year.

 Experience Required 

• Grade 12 diploma or equivalent.

• Minimum of two years’ experience working in manufacturing processes.

• Minimum of three years’ experience in welding and/or in the fabrication of parts using machines such as saws, brakes, lathes, and mills.

• Ability to read and understand blueprints, including welding diagrams and symbols.

• Ability to work with minimal supervision.

• Good verbal, and written communication skills.

• Experience in trouble shooting and problem solving.

• Able to perform considerable physical effort consisting of frequently lifting or moving average weight material in difficult work positions. The candidate must be physically able to wear a respirator while some tasks such as light painting.

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Proficiency in both MIG welding and operation of manual fabrication machines such as saws, brakes, lathes, and mills.

• Journeyperson certification in a related field. 

 Pay Transparency 

 The annual salary for this role is CAD $35.84 - $39.90 plus any applicable bonus (Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skill, experience and qualification for the role.)

 For roles open across multiple locations, the salary range indicated refers to the primary location. If a different location is considered, the applicable salary range will be communicated to candidates prior to the first interview.

 At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:

jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 As a Tooling Engineer, you will design, validate, and implement high-quality tooling and fixtures to enable efficient and safe manufacturing of complex aircraft structures. Collaborating with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality teams, you’ll support new product introduction and production scaling while staying closely connected to the production floor.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead and assist the air vehicle development team with new product designs to ensure manufacturability and validate processes/technology.

• Provide real-time manufacturing floor support, resolving tooling-related issues and collaborating with technicians and engineers to improve production processes.

• Conduct detailed tolerance stack-up and GD&T analysis of assemblies and their fixturing to ensure fit, function, and repeatability across production stages.

• Own and execute tool designs using CAD software.

• Understand and communicate tool access and machine access requirements.

• Select the best methods for producing parts, tools, or assemblies.

• Conduct root cause failure investigations and implement corrective actions.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• 5+ years of experience in production assembly/fabrication, including composites, metallics, and manufacturing operations for air vehicles (manned or unmanned).

• Demonstrated ability to distinguish critical design differences between prototype and production tooling.

• Experience with detailed tooling requirements for composite manufacturing processes, including lamination, curing, trimming, and assembly.

• Proficiency in designing mechanical parts using CAD. Understanding of manufacturing methods such as machining, sheet metal, composites, 3D printing, injection molding, and casting.

• BS in Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related Engineering discipline, or equivalent applicable experience.

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Experience using NX/Teamcenter.

• 5–10 years of experience in tool design.

• Familiarity with Full Scale Determinate Assembly (FSDA) is preferred.

• Aviation or automotive passion demonstrated through certifications, licenses, or hobbies.

• Aircraft development experience.

• Active U.S. Secret security clearance.

 $129,000 — $171,000 USD

 Benefits

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as operations and maintenance sites, as well as design teams), prepare and document mechanical design reviews, and provide technical support to production teams and customers, among other responsibilities. 

 You’ll specifically take care of developing 3D models, design annotations, and bills of materials, but also ensure quality checks for supplier and sub-contractor designs.

 Developing a complete technical Scope of Work for renovation and overhaul projects

 Creating and reviewing 3D models, 2D deliverables, and design annotations

 Conducting stack-up analysis and ensuring compliance with quality, cost, and delivery (QCD) commitments 

• 
 Preparing and documenting internal and external mechanical design reviews 

• 
 Designing products that meet project requirements, including manufacturability and serviceability 

• 
 Monitoring and reporting on mechanical activity progress, addressing potential issues 

• 
 Providing technical support to production teams and customers 

• 
 Ensuring supplier and sub-contractor design quality 

 All about you 

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role: 

• 
 BS Degree in Mechanical Engineering 

• 
 5+ years of experience in Mechanical Design Engineering or 2+ years in railway or railcar products (e.g., locomotives, rail passenger cars) 

• 
 Knowledge of metallic materials (physical properties and design) and industrial processes (welding, bending, machining) 

• 
 Familiarity with welding codes such as AWS 

• 
 Experience with Catia v5 (minimum 3+ years full-time or 5,000 hours) 

• 
 Preferred experience with PDM/PLM tools (e.g., Enovia-DMA, 3DCom) 

• 
 Preferred experience in overhaul projects and reverse engineering 

• 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including teamwork

 Time management and reporting skills with a sense of urgency and priority

 Structured and organized with a hands-on approach

 Fluent in English; knowledge of French is a bonus

 Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines 

• 
 Work with new security standards for rail signalling 

• 
 Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues 

• 
 Contribute to innovative projects 

• 
 Utilise our collaborative and forward-thinking working environment 

• 
 Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

 Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

 Progress towards senior mechanical engineering roles or other career paths

jobs.desc:
Req ID:531399 

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

 YOUR FUTURE ROLE 

• Manage industrialization team during development phase of the product. 

• Ensure the process is designed and implemented in line with the industrial requirements and the QCD objectives of the project. 

• Is the main industrialization contact for all other functions of the project, and thus represent PME department within the project. 

 WE’LL LOOK TO YOU TO: 

 DURING SPECIFICATION AND PRELIMINARY DESIGN PHASES: 

• Make sure that Industrial requirements are well understood and taken into account by Engineering, during product specification and design. 

• Monitor co-engineering activities with his Engineering counterpart. Animate ICONE workshops. 

• Design the global macro-process, based on standard SMP. 

• Prepare introduction of new technologies if need be, with associated process validation plan. 

• Build the plan for tooling and other specific manufacturing equipment. 

• Contribute to build the IMP (Industrial Management Plan) 

• Set up the industrialization planning including all activities: Co-engineering activities, P-FMEA, deliverables mile stones, FAR/FAI. 

• Build the IMFU (Industrial Maturity Follow-up) 

• Set up and monitor the Industrialization Work Package: Man hours and manufacturing equipment budget. This according to the industrial RefLib, if any. 

 DURING DETAILED DESIGN PHASE AND BEFORE SERIAL GO: 

• Manage the industrialization activity using IMFU. 

• Perform P-FMEA. 

• Ensure that industrial documentation is issued in due time with the good quality level. 

• Monitor the process Method Time vs target. 

• ensure the availability of tools and workstations on schedule and consistent with EHS requirements, ergonomics and quality. 

• Perform detailed line balancing and ensure the successful completion of the task sequencings. 

• Lead FAR and FAI activities in order to validate product design and process industrialization. 

 AFTER SERIAL GO: 

• Manage industrialization of the retrofit after engineering changes. 

• Contribute to build continuous improvement action plan along with Production to achieve manufacturing QCD targets. 

 OTHER ACTIVITIES: 

• Contributes to industrial costing during 

• Participates to R&D programs as industrial representative. 

• Perform industrial REX on manufacturing processes. 

 KPI`s 

• Project QCD on industrialization scope: 

 On time FAI and Serial Go. 

 Fixed industrialization cost in line with target. 

 Method Time in line with target. 

• APSYS Indus roadmap rating. 

 ALL ABOUT YOU 

 We value passion and attitude as much as experience. You do not need to meet every requirement; the following qualifications and experience will help you succeed and grow in this role: 

• Technical degree, preferably in manufacturing, mechanical or electrical 

• Manufacturing or Manufacturing Engineering background with 5 to 10 years’ experience preferably in the railway industry. 

• Technical experience of Process Engineering, writing manufacturing work instructions, line balancing, Lean Manufacturing. 

• Experience in project management. 

• Experience in working with an ERP (such as SAP) for Bill of Materials, Routings, Configuration follow-up 

• Working knowledge in Quality, EHS standards and Ergonomics. 

• Knowledge of CAD and PLM tools (CATIA, DELMIA…) 

• Familiar with IS common tools. 

• Process FMEA, QRQC. 

 THINGS YOU’LL ENJOY 

 Join us on a lifelong, transformative journey . The rail industry is built for the future, giving you opportunities to grow , develop new skills , and gain diverse experience throughout your career. 

 COMPETENCIES & SKILLS 

• Basic overall knowledge of railway products 

• Agility to juggle with schedules simulations, various scenarios, and changing project goals. 

• Rigorous, structured and sense of anticipation 

• Good Communications, interpersonal and leadership skills, excellent team worker 

• Conflict management and multi-tasking, 

• Collaborative management 

• Be able to challenge industrial teams and highly proactive in proposing solutions. 

• Comfortable in an international and a multi-cultural environment. 

• Balanced skills between management, industrial management and project management 

• Strong leadership and ability to federate teams on technical orientations to reach QCD targets 

• Demonstrated capacity to lead cross-functional activities and numerous/various stakeholders 

• Ability for analysis, problem-solving and efficient decision-making in complex environment 

• Ability to work across sites in a multi-cultural environment 

 YOU’LL ALSO: 

• Build a stable, challenging, long-term career with varied work. 

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues. 

• Contribute to innovative projects. 

• Shape your career across functions and countries. 

• Benefit from award-winning learning and development opportunities. 

• Receive a fair, dynamic reward package that recognises performance and potential, together with comprehensive and competitive social coverage.

 At Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, we're redefining aerospace through innovation, collaboration, and advanced engineering. 

 As a  Senior Design Engineer, Tooling , you'll design manufacturing tooling that enables the production of high-quality aerospace components while improving safety, ergonomics, efficiency, and operational performance.

 • Design and develop manufacturing tools that support safe, ergonomic, high-quality, and efficient production in accordance with Tool Design Manuals and aerospace industry best practices.

 • Partner with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, and Engineering teams to deliver tooling solutions that support production requirements and ensure compliance with engineering and quality standards.  
 • Investigate tooling and manufacturing issues by participating in Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA) activities and implementing effective corrective actions.

 Qualifications You Must Have   
 • Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of prior relevant experience unless prohibited by local laws/regulations.  
 • Advanced proficiency using CATIA V5 to create detailed 3D models, assemblies, and engineering drawings for manufacturing tooling.  
 • Experience designing tooling for composite layup, sheet metal fabrication, machining, and mechanical assembly manufacturing processes.  
 • Working knowledge of GD&T, engineering drawing interpretation, material properties, and standard hardware selection for tooling applications.  
 • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and support Root Cause & Corrective Action (RCCA) activities. 

 Qualifications We Prefer   
 • Knowledge of aerospace Tool Design Manuals and tooling design best practices.  
 • Experience supporting aerospace manufacturing or production environments.  
 • Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, and productivity.  
 • Familiarity with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles and manufacturing process optimization.  
 • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. 

 Learn More & Apply Now!

 Our Advanced Structures team leverages advanced materials and additive manufacturing to develop complex interior and exterior solutions. These solutions ensure structural integrity of the aircraft, help aircraft take off and land, stay trim in the air, move forward, carry cargo and conduct rescues. We delight our customers with superior products and best-in-class service. Our global team is committed to continuous improvement – we work hard to make our solutions lighter-weight, stronger and more technically advanced, so that plane travel can be safer, more affordable and more sustainable in the years to come. We are looking for the best and brightest to fly and land with us!

Collins Aerospace makes modern flight possible. Of course, that wouldn’t be possible without the capabilities and technologies of our organization, as well as our engineers – a highly skilled, accomplished network that spans more than 180 sites, 24 countries and 6 Strategic Business Units (SBUs).    

 Together, we will nurture an engineering culture that values intellectual curiosity, risk takers and integrity. A place where we will challenge ourselves, our teams, and the status quo and where we will work to find a way – the right way – to achieve what others can only dream of.

jobs.title: Tooling Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jobs.desc:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 TOOLING ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND) 

 SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical compute hardware, solar power systems, thermal radiators, and more. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference. 

 The Starmind team designs, builds, and operates the orbital compute fabric of the future. We develop nearly every key piece of technology in house – from the satellites’ flight computers and power systems to the fully custom compute electronics, memory, and networking that form the brain of our on-orbit data centers. As a Tooling Engineer on the Starmind team, you’ll have ownership over the entire manufacturing line for the hardware that enables advanced on-orbit AI processing and data center workloads. Your work spans the assembly, integration, and testing of industry-leading compute electronics, memory, and networking in order to achieve required domain sizes and processing workloads. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Develop machining capability in-house for the tool & die team and deliver high-quality precision piece parts required to build internal tooling 

• Analyze piece parts and assemblies for DFM to ensure that the parts are optimized for manufacturing and assembly 

• Create collaborative business plans with design engineering, upstream production, and support teams and develop and maintain positive supplier/customer relationships 

• Work between manufacturing and design engineers, machinists, technicians, and quality personnel to ensure processes are robust and any production problems are quickly solved 

• Implement machining process controls that allow parts to run ‘lights out’. Leverage latest technologies and programming strategies to reduce in-cycle intervention 

• Identify, recommend, procure, and install machine shop equipment as well as ensure all equipment is thoroughly maintained and calibrated 

• Responsible for cost optimization and cost reduction initiatives associated with fabrication and processes 

• Continually develop and manage engineering capacity, schedules, and project plans in order to support production manifest as well as a diverse and variable R&D demand 

• Research and identify new materials, manufacturing technologies and finishing options 

• Inform estimations of prototype and production manufacturing costs - tooling, secondary assembly, secondary finishing and piece part 

• Publish and maintain detailed schedules for each development project segment 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline 

• 3+ years of experience with CNC machining 

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

• Master’s degree or PhD in an engineering discipline 

• Strong to expert level 3D CAD skills, including advanced surfacing and large assemblies 

• Experience with Siemens NX 

• Experience transitioning products from design to manufacturing and scaling to high volume as part of a cross-functional team 

• Experience with manufacturing process like injection molding, CNC, die casting, stamping, assembly, and box build in a production setting and a good understanding of the costs and schedule and complexity associated with each process 

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:  

• Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines

jobs.desc:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 TOOLING ENGINEER, PLASTIC INJECTION MOLDING (STARLINK) 

 SpaceX is developing a low-latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. 

 Working directly in the materials engineering group, this position is responsible for the development, qualification, and implementation of all tooling and manufacturing process technologies required to deliver the right scalable solution at the right cost on time. The correct individual will bring an open mindset, challenge the status quo with regard to traditional vs. emerging technologies, and utilize a logical and disciplined approach to evaluate and select the correct set of solutions. The candidate will drive alignment between design, material, and process selection and will own the seamless integration of these processes into the overall process flow. 

 The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in consumer electronics product and tooling development with domestic as well as Asian suppliers, tooling material selection, resin selection, and qualification, high volume manufacturing, secondary processes, DOE experience and the ability to run multiple programs in parallel with excellent communication and collaboration skills. 

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Lead the development of new plastic injection tooling projects to meet a wide range of product performance and cosmetic requirements 

• Lead and refine the design for manufacturing process by collaborating with supply management, product design, industrial design, and manufacturing engineering groups on material selection, design feasibility, and aesthetics of new plastic part and tooling designs 

• Research and identify new materials, manufacturing technologies, and finish options 

• Inform estimations of prototype and production manufacturing costs - tooling, secondary assembly, secondary finishing, and piece part 

• Participate in supplier audits and final supplier selection 

• Write prototype/development tooling request for quotes (RFQs) 

• Publish and maintain a live master tooling schedule 

• Conduct final approval for tooling design by performing DFM with supplier, including reviewing draft, gating strategy, Moldflow, and Mold Warp analysis 

• Review and approve prototype/development tool designs, and tooling maintenance procedures 

• Track suppliers' weekly build progress while participating in T1 samples 

• Conduct final approval for releasing tooling to production teams by assessing part quality at tooling trials. This includes generating first article inspection (FAI) reports, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) reports to ensure parts meet drawing and design specifications 

• Decide corrective actions and direct tooling teams to perform tooling modifications when parts to not conform to design specifications 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: 

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, materials engineering or other engineering discipline; OR 10+ years of professional experience engineering injection mold tools in lieu of a degree 

• 5+ years of professional experience in direct hands-on injection mold design and/or injection mold construction 

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

• 10+ years of experience in direct hands-on injection mold design and/or injection mold construction

• Strong to expert-level 3D CAD skills, including advanced surfacing and large assemblies 

• Siemens NX fluency or must be able to learn and adopt it quickly as it will be the design package used 

• Knowledge and experience in scientific molding/RJG molding 

• Strong experience in setting up and performing detailed mold simulations (Autodesk Moldflow) 

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: Senior Tooling Engineer
jobs.desc:
Job descriptions may display in multiple languages   based on your language selection. 

 What we offer: 
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

 Group Summary: 
 Cosma provides a comprehensive range of body, chassis and engineering solutions to global customers. Through our robust product engineering, outstanding tooling capabilities and diverse process expertise, we continue to bring lightweight and innovative products to market.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 • Design and optimize high-pressure die casting tooling, including gating, runner, cooling, vacuum, sealing, and trim systems to achieve superior product quality, productivity, and casting yield.
• Develop die seal concepts and vacuum system solutions to maximize vacuum performance and minimize leakage.
• Design and validate cooling systems to ensure thermal balance, dimensional stability, optimal cycle times, and consistent casting quality.
• Drive tooling and process improvements across global casting operations, including hydraulic cores/slides, squeeze cores, jet-cooled cores, vacuum systems, and related technologies.
• Provide technical expertise to improve tooling performance through optimized materials, coatings, and tooling practices that extend die life and reduce soldering.
• Establish, maintain, and deploy global die and tooling standards to improve production efficiency, casting yield, quality, and cost competitiveness.
• Analyze thermal imaging, casting data, and tooling performance to identify opportunities for process and tooling optimization.
• Conduct dimensional capability studies and implement corrective actions to improve product quality and process capability.
• Apply proactive engineering methodologies, including FMEA, risk assessment, and lessons learned, to ensure successful program launches and first-time-pass objectives.
• Utilize Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles to assess product feasibility, tooling concepts, and manufacturing readiness.
• Collaborate with simulation and manufacturing teams to correlate simulation results with production trials and optimize casting performance.
• Lead standardization of GD&T interpretation and casting tolerance requirements for structural die-cast components.
• Partner with global tooling suppliers to evaluate tooling concepts, costs, lead times, and technical feasibility.
• Develop and implement engineering tools, calculations, CAD standards, and automation solutions to improve design efficiency and reduce engineering lead times.
• Support customer discussions to finalize product designs, technical specifications, and manufacturing requirements while meeting quality, cost, delivery, and productivity targets.
• Maintain and improve CAD data management systems for products, tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing equipment.
• Capture, document, and share best practices and lessons learned across global casting operations.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting expertise for casting processes, tooling, downstream manufacturing processes, and value engineering initiatives.
• Support new product and process development activities focused on performance improvement and cost reduction.

 Qualification requirements 
 • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field.
• Several years of experience in High Pressure Die Casting (HPDC), preferably within the automotive industry.
• Demonstrated experience in die design, gating systems, runner design, cooling system design, and tooling development.
• Strong understanding of HPDC process fundamentals, tooling design principles, and casting defect prevention.
• Proven ability to assess manufacturing feasibility from component drawings, specifications, and assemblies.

jobs.title: Tooling Designer, High Pressure Die Casting
jobs.desc:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 TOOLING DESIGNER, HIGH PRESSURE DIE CASTING 

 SpaceX is seeking a Tooling Designer for High Pressure Die Casting, to own the design and development of die casting tools and trim dies used to produce casted components. This role is critical to scaling reliable, high-performance components. You will design complex tooling that must repeatedly deliver extremely tight tolerances and reliable performance while supporting aggressive rate and cost targets. 

 As a member of the materials team, you will work closely with materials, casting, and manufacturing engineers to develop tooling solutions from concept through production qualification. Your designs will directly impact casting yield, dimensional stability, and the overall manufacturability of mission-critical hardware.  

 RESPONSIBILITIES :  

• Design high-precision die casting tooling and trim dies to be manufactured and used in-house  

• Interpret and enable casting simulations and apply first-principles analysis to optimize gating, venting, cooling, and warp compensation  

• Account for shrinkage, warpage, and solidification to consistently meet stringent dimensional and metallurgical requirements  

• Own tooling designs from concept through tryout, qualification, and production release  

• Collaborate closely casting engineers, materials scientists, and vendors to troubleshoot tooling-related casting defects and improve yield  

• Apply advanced GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis to complex airfoil geometries  

• Support design for manufacturability (DFM) initiatives to enable high-rate production while maintaining quality and cost targets  

• Interface with internal manufacturing teams and external tooling vendors to ensure designs are successfully translated into reliable production tooling  

• Drive continuous improvement of tooling standards, materials, and maintenance practices for high-volume casting operations  

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:   

• 3+ years of professional experience designing high pressure die casting molds 

• Experience with Siemens NX  

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:   

• In-depth knowledge of high pressure die casting tooling design 

• Extensive knowledge of high pressure die casting tool design requirements  

• Experience designing structural aluminum die casting dies 

• Demonstrated success taking complex tooling from design through production qualification  

• Deep understanding of the die casting process and associated shrinkage/ distortion mechanisms  

• Experience working in a fast-paced, high-mix manufacturing environment  

• Hands-on experience supporting die tryouts and casting process development  

• Experience with manufacturing die cast tooling, including CNC and tool making  

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:   

• Willingness to work extended hours and weekends when required to support hardware delivery and production campaigns  

• Must be willing to travel (up to 25%) to external suppliers and other SpaceX facilities  

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS: 

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . 

 SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

 Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

jobs.title: Welding Mechanical Design Engineer

Req ID:528717 

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

 Could you be the full-time Welding Mechanical Design Engineer in St-Bruno, Quebec, Canada we’re looking for?

 Your future role 

 The Welding Mechanical Design Engineer is responsible for the design, development, and industrialisation support of welded structural assemblies used in railway vehicles. The role combines structural design engineering expertise with advanced welding engineering knowledge to ensure that products are designed for structural performance, manufacturability, quality, certification and contractual compliance, and cost efficiency.

 The position serves as the key interface between Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Industrialisation, Suppliers, and Shared Engineering Centres to ensure that welded structures meet project requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

 The successful candidate will contribute directly to the continuous improvement of welding technologies, fabrication methods, and design standards while supporting production sites across North America.

 Structural Design Engineering 

• Perform detailed Technical Review of 3D design of carbody structures, subassemblies, and welded components.

• Needs to be proficient with following aspects of Structural Design:

• Load cases and structural requirements.

• Manufacturing and assembly constraints.

• Weight, cost, and quality targets.

• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, technical referential, and customer requirements.

 Welding Engineering Expertise 

• Act as the structural design focal point for all welding-related design activities.

 Participate at the definition and optimization of welded joint designs to ensure:

• Structural integrity and fatigue performance.

• Ease of fabrication and assembly.

• Weld accessibility.

• Distortion and residual stress control.

• Cost-effective production.

• Inspection accessibility and maintainability.

• Support, at occasion, development and qualification of welding procedures including:

• GMAW (MIG)

• FCAW / MCAW

• GTAW (TIG)

• Resistance Spot Welding (RSW)

• Laser Welding

• Participate, at occasion, in welding procedure qualification activities (WPQR/PQR) and support development of Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS).

• Provide engineering support for welding inspections and manufacturing audits.

• Contribute to the maintenance of welding certifications and compliance with applicable standards such as: EN, AWS and CSA

• Support technology transfer of welding methods and best practices to manufacturing sites and suppliers.

• Participate in the evaluation and introduction of new welding technologies and manufacturing processes.

 Manufacturing & Quality Support 

• Provide technical support to manufacturing teams during production and troubleshooting activities.

• Investigate welding non-conformities and manufacturing defects.

• Lead or contribute to root cause analysis and corrective action implementation.

• Participate in failure mode analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Support First Article Inspection (FAI), production readiness reviews, and manufacturing validation activities.

• Collaborate with Industrialisation and Quality teams to improve product robustness and manufacturability.

 Collaboration & Project Support 

 Work closely with:

• Structural Integrity Engineers

• Industrial Engineers

• Manufacturing Engineers

• Quality Engineers

• Mechanical Integration Teams

• Supplier Quality teams

• External fabrication partners

• Contribute to design reviews and technical risk assessments.

• Provide weight and technical data for project reporting.

• Support optimisation activities through collaboration with Structural Integrity specialists.

 All about you 

 Education 

• Bachelor Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, or equivalent.

• Welding Engineering Certification:

• 

• IWE (International Welding Engineer), or

• AWS Certified Welding Engineer (CWE), or

• CWB Welding Engineer Certification

 Professional Membership 

• Professional Engineer designation (P.Eng. / OIQ or equivalent professional engineering registration).

 Experience 

 Required 

• Minimum 3 years of experience in mechanical or structural engineering.

• Experience designing welded structures in an industrial environment.

• Experience with fabrication drawings and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience supporting production, manufacturing, or industrialisation activities.

 Preferred 

• Railway rolling stock experience.

• Heavy manufacturing, transportation, aerospace, shipbuilding, or steel structure experience.

• Experience with aluminium and stainless-steel welded assemblies.

• Experience working with suppliers and subcontractors.

 Languages

The world is counting on us to feed billions of people and build vital infrastructures in villages, towns and megacities.  As a   Machine Hand / Tool Room Machinist   with John Deere in Dubuque, IA, you will:  

 Set up and operate one or more machines such as lathes, mills, horizontal boring machine, etc., and perform machining operations consisting of many details on a wide variety of non-repetitive parts, holding close tolerances.  Work will be performed in a production environment focused on safety, quality, and teamwork.  

 Job details are dependent on duties assigned but in general consist of the following:  

• Work from drawings, sketches, prints, 3D models, samples, written or verbal instructions.  

• Perform own setups, work from part prints and job specifications.  

• Plan sequence of work to be performed and determine tools and equipment needed to carry work to completion.

 Minimum Qualifications:
