 L’opportunité 

 Hitachi Énergie est à la recherche d’un(e) Ingénieur(e) manufacturier(e) pour joindre son équipe de fabrication à Varennes. Dans ce rôle concret et axé sur le terrain, vous serez responsable de la performance manufacturière, de la stabilité des procédés et des initiatives d’amélioration continue au sein d’un secteur de production désigné. Vous consacrerez environ 50 % de votre temps au plancher de production en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes des opérations, de la qualité, de la maintenance et de l’ingénierie afin de soutenir des processus de fabrication sécuritaires, efficaces et standardisés. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résolution des défis de production, la mise en œuvre d’améliorations manufacturières, l’intégration de nouveaux équipements et le déploiement d’initiatives visant à améliorer la productivité, la qualité et les coûts. Grâce à l’optimisation des procédés fondée sur les données, aux activités d’amélioration continue et à la collaboration interfonctionnelle, votre travail contribuera directement à l’excellence opérationnelle, à la fiabilité manufacturière et à la livraison de solutions énergétiques innovantes favorisant un réseau électrique plus durable et résilient.

 Comment vous aurez un impact 
 • Soutenir la performance manufacturière, la stabilité des procédés et les initiatives d’amélioration continue dans un secteur de fabrication assigné.

• Fournir un soutien technique pratique sur le plancher de production afin de résoudre les problèmes manufacturiers et d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle.

• Développer, maintenir et améliorer les standards de production, les instructions de travail et la documentation liée à l’amélioration des processus.

• Animer des activités structurées de résolution de problèmes, incluant les méthodologies RCCM, Kaizen, RPS et ABRA.

• Soutenir les livrables APQP, incluant l’élaboration et la mise à jour des PFMEA afin d’identifier et de réduire les risques manufacturiers.

• Participer à l’intégration et à la mise en service d’équipements de production ainsi qu’aux activités de FAT/SAT et de validation manufacturière.

• Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires pour soutenir l’introduction de nouveaux produits, les activités d’industrialisation et la préparation manufacturière.

• Surveiller les indicateurs de performance (KPI), réaliser des études de temps et utiliser les données manufacturières afin d’identifier des opportunités d’amélioration en matière de sécurité, qualité, livraison et coûts.

• Veiller au respect des réglementations, procédures et directives internes et externes applicables.

 Votre profil 
 • Le candidat doit déjà disposer d’une autorisation de travail lui permettant de travailler pour Hitachi Énergie au Canada.

• Baccalauréat en génie électrique, mécanique, industriel, manufacturier ou dans une discipline connexe en ingénierie.

• De 2 à 7 années d’expérience pertinente.

• Une expérience dans un environnement d’ingénierie manufacturière constitue un atout.

• Connaissance des systèmes de contrôle manufacturiers, de l’optimisation manufacturière et des pratiques d’amélioration continue en milieu de fabrication.

• Expérience avec les méthodologies de résolution de problèmes à la source, incluant RCCM, Kaizen et les principes Lean.

• Expérience dans le soutien de projets d’équipements de production ainsi qu’une capacité à interpréter les données manufacturières, les indicateurs de performance et les études de temps.

• Membre de l’Ordre des ingénieurs du Québec (OIQ), un atout.

• Bilinguisme (français et anglais).

 En savoir plus sur nous 
 Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l’occasion de développer votre expertise en ingénierie manufacturière tout en collaborant avec des professionnels expérimentés engagés envers l’excellence opérationnelle et l’avenir de l’énergie.
 • Travaillez sur des technologies innovantes qui contribuent à façonner l’avenir de l’énergie.

• Collaborez avec des professionnels expérimentés de l’industrie de l’énergie.

• Accédez à des plateformes d’apprentissage et à des occasions de développement de carrière.

• Profitez de programmes avantageux en matière de santé et de retraite.

• Bénéficiez de congés payés et de modalités de travail flexibles.

 Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt. Toutefois, seules les personnes retenues pour une entrevue seront contactées. 

 The Opportunity 

 Hitachi Energy is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to join our manufacturing team in Varennes. In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for manufacturing performance, stability, and continuous improvement within an assigned production area. You will spend approximately 50% of your time on the production floor, partnering closely with operations, quality, maintenance, and engineering teams to support safe, efficient, and standardized manufacturing processes. You will play a key role in resolving production challenges, implementing manufacturing improvements, supporting capital equipment integration, and driving productivity, quality, and cost initiatives. Through data-driven manufacturing optimization, continuous improvement activities, and collaboration across functions, your work will directly contribute to operational excellence, manufacturing reliability, and the delivery of innovative energy solutions that support a more sustainable and resilient power grid.

jobs.desc:
Industrial Engineer Zelisko Energy, USA 

 LOCATION: Springfield /  United States  | BRAND: Zelisko | REQUISITION ID:  11490   |  ON-SITE/REMOTE:  Hybrid 

 Zelisko GmbH is a subsidiary of the Knorr-Bremse GmbH specialized in energy, traffic engineering and ticket printers. Wouldn’t it be great to play an active part in shaping the future of mobility? For our location in Mödling we are looking for . 

 The Industrial Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving manufacturing processes to achieve operational excellence, cost efficiency, and productivity improvements. This role drives process optimization initiatives, supports investment planning, implements lean manufacturing principles, and collaborates across functions to ensure a synchronized and high-performing production environment. The position plays a key role in supporting innovation and contributing to the future of sustainable mobility.

 Key Responsibilities 

• Design, develop, and implement measures to optimize manufacturing processes, productivity, quality, and operational performance.

• Define, evaluate, and budget planned production investments, ensuring alignment with business objectives and operational requirements.

• Establish performance indicators and monitor the effectiveness of process improvements and manufacturing optimization initiatives.

• Introduce and support synchronized manufacturing processes, driving balanced production flow and implementing pull-system principles.

• Identify waste throughout production processes and eliminate root causes of machine and process-related issues to improve efficiency and productivity.

• Manage external development partners and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and according to quality standards.

• Collaborate closely with all departments across the production value chain, including Production, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and Finance.

• Conduct and coordinate training programs on newly implemented workflows, processes, and continuous improvement methodologies within the Energy Team.

• Support innovation and contribute to shaping solutions of the future through advanced manufacturing concepts and technologies.

• Negotiate and finalize finance-related contract agreements and intercompany agreements in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and other operational excellence methodologies.

• Ensure compliance with company standards, safety regulations, and applicable industry requirements.

 Qualifications 

 Education 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline from a University of Applied Sciences or Technical University.

 Experience 

• Several years of professional experience in the planning, implementation, and optimization of production and manufacturing processes.

• Proven experience managing process improvement and operational excellence projects in a manufacturing environment.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams and external partners.

 Knowledge and Skills 

• Strong knowledge of process management and continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and related tools.

• Solid understanding of manufacturing systems, production planning, process optimization, and productivity improvement techniques.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.

• Excellent project management and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.

• Proficiency in standard engineering and productivity analysis tools.

 Personal Attributes 

• Team-oriented with excellent interpersonal skills.

• Proactive, organized, and results-driven personality.

• Independent, self-motivated, and solution-oriented working style.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Adaptable and capable of working effectively in a dynamic environment.

 Additional Requirements 

• Willingness to travel approximately 20%.

• Fluent English language skills; additional languages are considered an advantage.

 Training Austria 

 Yes, 2-3 months.

The final pay offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, the type of years and experience within the industry and education.  •         编制并维护 SOP、CP（控制计划）、PFMEA 等制程技术文件
 2. 制程质量与改善
 •         监控产线制程良率，主导不良品分析（虚焊、连锡、立碑、偏移、缺件等常见缺陷），制定改善对策并跟踪验证
 •         运用 SPC、CPK 等工具对关键工序参数进行监控与能力提升
 •         参与客户审核及体系审核（IATF 16949 等），负责制程相关问题的回复与整改
 3. 客户沟通与项目管理
 •         对接客户（特别是日系客户），就制程技术问题进行沟通与汇报
 •         参与客户样品试制、工程变更（ECN/ECO）的评估与执行
 •         配合质量部门完成客户投诉（8D 报告）中制程相关的分析与改善
 4. 其他
 •         产线工装夹具、钢网、治具的需求评估与验收
 •         产线操作员及技术员的工艺培训
 •         上级交办的其他工作

 Your Background 
 一、核心要求    [ 权重 70% — 80% ]
 1. SMT 制程专长（必须具备）
 •            3 年以上 SMT / PCBA 制程工程师工作经验，能独立负责产线制程管理
 •            熟练掌握以下全部工艺环节的参数设定、调试与优化：
 贴片（SMT）：锡膏印刷、贴片程序、回流焊温度曲线设定与优化
 Eberhand 插针（优先）：Eberhand 自动插针设备的程序调试与制程管控
 鲜一插针（Sunil）（优先）：鲜一（Sunil）插针设备的工艺参数设定与质量管控
 Coating：三防漆涂覆工艺，膜厚控制、流平性与覆盖率管控
 波峰焊：波峰焊温度曲线、助焊剂参数、焊接质量优化
 2. 汽车电子行业经验（优先）
 •            有汽车电子产品（控制盒、保险丝盒、配电盒等）SMT 制程经验者优先
 •            熟悉 IATF 16949 体系要求，了解 APQP、PPAP、PFMEA、SPC、MSA 五大工具
 •            有车规级产品（如 HNS、低压保险丝盒、PDU/BDU、IDU 等）制程经验者尤佳

 二、加分要求    [ 权重 20% — 30% ]
 日系客户经验（优先）
 •            有服务日系客户的经验，了解日系客户的工作风格与质量要求
 •            熟悉日系客户的审核流程、报告格式与沟通方式
 •            有丰田（Toyota）客户项目经验者优先考虑
 •            能用日语进行工作沟通者加分（非必须）

 三、通用要求
 •            本科及以上学历，电子、机械、自动化、材料工程等相关专业
 •            能熟练使用 Office 办公软件，具备基本的制程数据统计分析能力
 •            具备较强的逻辑分析能力和问题解决能力，能主导跨部门协作
 •            工作态度端正，有责任心，能适应一定程度的加班和产线现场工作环境

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold.  Anduril’s Manufacturing team is seeking an Industrial Engineer to join our team. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware, including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles. As an Industrial Engineer, you will have responsibility for optimizing Anduril’s manufacturing operations for best-in-class quality, reliability, speed, and asset utilization, all while meeting critical customer deployment and internal development timelines. The Industrial Engineer will be instrumental in taking a data-driven approach to designing production lines and associated manufacturing processes to meet these objectives. Executing on this responsibility will entail active collaboration with other Anduril teams, including but not limited to Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, and Business Operations. 

 The right person for this role can demonstrate past holistic ownership on solving operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you. 

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Own the metrics, KPIs, and reporting associated with monitoring production line health and efficiency, such as cycle time, throughput rate, capacity, utilization, first pass yield, cycle time, and all Quality metrics 

• Produce and maintain tools and reports to communicate the health of manufacturing operations across products both to Manufacturing leads and across the organization 

• Own the design of new production lines and work station layouts, both for low rate and full-rate production, leveraging a data-driven approach using tools such as Value Stream Mapping/ Process Mapping/ Line Balancing techniques

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Must be pursuing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

• Able to start full time in 2027.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Past experience in a high-rate manufacturing environment in either a production or supply chain-type role where complex mechanical and/or electrical assemblies were built with heavy data utilization 

• Factory design and set up - Value Stream mapping, Flow lines, continuous flow, one piece flow, workstation design 

• Material Flow - designing how material flow around a facility, pull systems, Kanban, Min/ max calculations, Part presentation to operator, Tote bin packaging, lineside racking. 

• Digital Systems - experience of using Siemens "Plant Simulation", "Process Simulation" software to model a production line and run production scenarios. 

• Demonstrated ability to completely own a value chain from start to finish, coordinating among multiple different internal and external parties to achieve on-time deliveries under stringent quality standards 

• Prior knowledge and interaction with a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) for production operations 

• Prior knowledge of NetSuite or a similar Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system 

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing principles/implementation 

• Subject matter expert in material flow systems 

• Ability to demonstrate a willingness to take on substantial responsibility across manufacturing, engineering, and operations functions with a bias towards speed and accuracy 

• Strong technical ability to read technical documentation such as drawings and CAD data, understanding of a variety of hardware manufacturing processes for both electronics (PCBAs, sensor hardware, etc.) and structures, mechanical components, and electromechanical systems 

• Experience interacting with SQL databases - storage of information and building custom queries for tracking production and inventory-related metrics 

• Experience with production simulation software (Siemens/PlantSim/ProcessSim)

 Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

 SPACE SYSTEMS 

 At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

 Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions

 As a Production Engineer based at Rocket Lab’s site in Albuquerque, New Mexico, you will be part of a team responsible for process improvements, yield and day to day sustaining work in the solar cell (III-V semiconductors) and silicon-based production processes. In this role you will take ownership of Photolithography systems (Coat/Expose/Develop) and the associated metrology. To be successful in this role, you must be data driven and possess a high degree of area ownership. You will need to be able to build solid relationships across all levels of the company, this includes operators on the production floor, equipment maintenance personnel, and R&D engineers. In this role you will join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space!

 WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO: 

• Support sustaining activities to maximize yield and productivity of fab operation across work centers in the litho area

jobs.title: Supplier Industrialization Engineer, PCB (Starlink)
jobs.desc:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 SUPPLIER INDUSTRIALIZATION ENGINEER, PCB (STARLINK) 

 SpaceX is growing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink provides fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. Starlink is also looking to develop AI data centers in space and grow our Starlink Mobile (Direct to Cell) network with next-generation technology. We are looking for talented, creative, and driven engineers to develop, drive, and maintain suppliers to grow these programs, from initial concept development to full scale production.

 This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of Satellites and Gateways. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering and manufacturing teams as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. With integration taking place in-house, supplier development engineers can see their assemblies come to life every day!

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

• Own continuity of supply for printed circuit boards (PCBs) on the Starlink program

• Collaborate with design, R&D, commercial supply chain, hardware reliability, and production teams to manage suppliers and deliver world class products for our customers

• Support procurement team to strategically source parts matched with supplier capabilities by reviewing and assessing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems

• Identify, audit, and onboard new suppliers

• Develop and implement supplier technical requirements and quality flow downs to meet hardware manufacturing needs

• Implement and monitor production part approval process (PPAP) with selected suppliers to enable rate production

• Ensure qualification and reliability activities at suppliers are in line with requirements

• Develop and approve process controls to control critical characteristics

• Recommend technical product improvements to reduce risk and opportunities for defects

• Analyze supplier quality and delivery metrics to identify trends and pinpoint systemic performance gaps to drive supplier improvement plans

• Provide feedback to suppliers as appropriate on manufacturing methods, with a specific focus on eliminating costs, reducing cycle times, and increasing yields

• Function as liaison between purchasing, engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support

• Drive supplier root cause failure analysis and corrective actions associated with any quality gaps, escapes, or containments

• Lead projects and present reports to internal teams, management, and/or suppliers

• Act as internal owner of supplier’s statistical process control (SPC), yield improvement activities, new tool/process qualification, and performance in terms of quality, efficiency, and cost

• Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline

• Experience with printed circuit boards (PCBs), engineering laminates, electrochemical processes, and/or microelectronics fabrication (school projects, clubs, or internship experience is applicable)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 

• Advanced degree in engineering, business, or supply chain

• Electronics manufacturing experience, preferably with PCBs for high-speed / RF applications

• Working knowledge of supplier quality processes (PPAP, APQP, FAIR, RCCA failure analysis, lean methods, etc.) and quality systems (ISO 9000/TS/AS9100/NADCAP)

• Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods, e.g., SPC, design of experiments, Six Sigma, etc.

• Disciplined approach to problem solving – 8D

• Experience with sharing information and influencing others across organizational lines, internally and externally

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with minimal oversight and learn new skills on-the-job quickly and efficiently

• Ability to identify and maintain priorities for tasks and projects while staying organized

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, ability to make presentations to suppliers, team members and management

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: 

• Willingness to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines

• Ability to travel: Up to 25-60% travel required (domestic and international)

• Valid driver’s license

 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

 Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 

 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture. Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.

 Une offre de stage intitulée « Contribution de l'IA à l'industrialisation de pales d'hélicoptère (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus Helicopters sur son site de Paris le Bourget.

 Vous rejoindrez le département « Manufacturing Engineering » qui fait le lien entre la conception d'un produit et sa production en série. Son objectif principal est de concevoir, d'optimiser et de maintenir les procédés de fabrication pour produire au meilleur coût, dans les délais et avec le niveau de qualité requis.

 Votre stage consistera à: déployer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle dans les outils et processus métier liés aux méthodes.

 ● Identifier des cas d'usage et définir le business case associé (couts, gains et planning).
 ● Réaliser des démonstrations et preuves de concept sur des sujets concrets: gestion des non conformités, industrialisation de nouveaux produits, etc..
 ● En lien avec les référents métier (IA et méthode), contribuer au développement, au déploiement et à l'évaluation de ses solutions.

 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.

 ● Méthodes appliquées aux matériaux composites et pièces critiques
 ● Modèles IA
 ● Gestion de projet

 Vous êtes actuellement en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur (ou Master 2) en Ingénierie industrielle ou un domaine équivalent.

 ○ Passionné par le secteur aéronautique, vous conjuguez un gout du terrain (procédés de fabrication, matériaux composites, etc..) avec une excellente culture informatique (outils IA)

 ● Soft Skills : 
 ○ Volontaire
 ○ Curieux et pro-actif, votre investissement vous permettra de mener à bien vos missions.

 ● Langues : 
 ○ Anglais : Professionnel 
 ○ Français : Courant

 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer for Avionics to join our team. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability at Anduril.

As the Manufacturing Engineer for Avionics, you will own the manufacturing processes for the flight computing, guidance and navigation, and radio-frequency avionics that fly on our spacecraft. Your responsibilities span process development and documentation, Design for Manufacturability, assembly tooling and test equipment, and the workmanship standards these assemblies are built to. You will work hands-on with technicians on the floor and report to the Lead Manufacturing Engineer for Sensors and Avionics.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on electronics manufacturing engineer who has taken flight or comparably high-reliability electronic assemblies from development into production, and who is comfortable working from incomplete design data in a fast-paced environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

• Own manufacturing process development and documentation for flight computer, GNC and RF avionics assemblies — PCBA, box-level build and integrated unit assembly — to IPC-610/620 Class 3, IPC J-STD-001 Space Addendum and the NASA-STD-8739 series.

• Author and maintain work instructions, travelers and as-built records for the assemblies you own.

• Drive Design for Manufacturability and Assembly into avionics designs before CDR — component selection and screening, testability, connector access and harness routing.

• Specify and qualify assembly tooling, fixtures and test equipment for avionics build, and support the test station interface with Test Operations.

• Own root cause analysis, PFMEA, process validation and first article inspection for avionics processes, and disposition nonconformances on flight hardware.

• Support incoming acceptance of development and COTS avionics units, and feed manufacturability and workmanship findings back to the Lead for vendor and partner engagement.

• Work RF-specific handling discipline into production practice — ESD, connector torque and mating cycles, cleanliness — and train technicians to it.

• Act as an owner and evangelist for Anduril's Manufacturing Development Process (MDP), and use Foundry and Teamcenter as the system of record for build definition, work instructions and as-built records.

• Support design reviews (PDR, CDR) and manufacturing readiness reviews for avionics scope.

• Provide hands-on technical support to the technicians building avionics assemblies, on the floor.

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of manufacturing engineering experience on electronic assemblies in aerospace, space, defense or another high-reliability industry.

• Working knowledge of high-reliability electronics workmanship standards — IPC-610/620 Class 3, IPC J-STD-001 Space Addendum, NASA-STD-8739 series.

• Hands-on experience with PCBA processes (SMT, through-hole, conformal coating, potting, component screening) and box-level assembly (cabling, harnessing, mechanical integration, thermal, EMI/EMC).

• Has authored work instructions or travelers for flight or comparably high-consequence electronic hardware.

• Experience with root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone), PFMEA and first article inspection.

• Hands-on mindset with a demonstrated willingness to work on the floor alongside technicians.

• Willingness to travel up to 25%

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• 10+ years flight avionics manufacturing experience — flight computers, GNC units, transponders, radios or RF front ends.

• RF or microwave assembly and test experience, including connector and cable discipline.

• Cleanroom manufacturing with contamination control and ESD discipline.

• MES and PLM fluency — Foundry, Teamcenter, SAP or equivalent — for work instruction authoring and as-built records.

• Took an electronics product from prototype or LRIP into rate production.

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

jobs.title: Senior Industrial Engineer, Layouts
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM

 Anduril's Manufacturing Design Team is seeking a Senior Industrial Engineer to own and scale our central manufacturing layout capability and system. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware — including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles — and scaling these products across our production footprint, including our new 5M sq ft manufacturing facility, Arsenal-1.

 Within Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering delivers layout design as an internal service: enterprise-grade production layouts that define where and how products are built — from cell and line configurations through material flow paths to full facility arrangements. Done right, layouts de-risk production ramps, eliminate waste in material handling and operator movement, maximize throughput per square foot, and give leadership a single, trusted spatial reference for every capital, capacity, and footprint decision. This role sets the standard for how that capability is architected, maintained, and consumed across the company, in close collaboration with Facilities, Real Estate, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Business Operations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 This is not a "draw a layout and move on" role. We are looking for a senior engineer who can demonstrate holistic ownership of Anduril's factory layout capability as a durable, enterprise-wide asset — one that lives for years, absorbs changes as production systems evolve, and is trusted by leadership to make fast / efficient / standard facility, capital, and capacity decisions. The right person thrives in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment, is flexible to change and ambiguity, and can act as the connective tissue among operational stakeholders to bring a production system forward.

 The mandate is bigger than any single layout. Anduril operates across multiple sites with diverse product lines at varying maturity stages — conditions where ad-hoc layouts drawn in PowerPoint or disconnected CAD files create confusion, rework, and missed opportunities. You will decide how layouts are created, versioned, maintained, stored / “libraried”, and consumed so that "where does this line go?", "how much floor space do we need for rate?", and "what's the material flow path?" become queries against a maintained, centralized system — not one-off drawings that go stale the week they're delivered.

 Beyond the production floor, the preferred candidate has experience or connection to overall facility design — building shell, infrastructure integration, dock and staging areas, material flow, utility routing, and the interface between manufacturing layout and the physical plant. You will work hand-in-hand with Facilities and Real Estate to ensure that production layouts and building infrastructure are designed as an integrated system, not in isolation.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own Anduril's enterprise manufacturing layout capability as a long-lived, foundational asset — architecting it for maintainability, extensibility, and organizational adoption rather than single-use drawings. Work closely with IT and Tech Teams to integrate into existing business systems.

• Design production line and workstation layouts for both low-rate and full-rate production using a data-driven approach, incorporating cell design, flow configuration, material staging, operator movement, and ergonomic considerations rooted in IE tradition.

• Establish and maintain a centralized layout repository — the single source of truth for all production layouts across sites — that integrates with Facilities, Real Estate, and infrastructure planning so building shell decisions and production floor decisions are made from the same spatial model.

• Build and curate a centralized CAD shape library of standard manufacturing elements (workbenches, tables, cabinets, tool storage, chairs, racks, conveyors, carts, etc.) so that every layout across the organization uses consistent, dimensionally accurate components — reducing layout creation time and ensuring visual and spatial consistency.

• Define the enterprise standards for layout creation: file formats, naming conventions, layer structures, revision control, approval workflows, and the entrenched business processes that ensure layouts are created, reviewed, updated, and archived consistently across all sites and business lines.

• Deploy those standards across the organization — selecting and implementing the tools, software, and mechanisms needed, training layout consumers and contributors, and building the governance structure that keeps the system healthy as the organization scales.

• Support facility-level layout planning for new buildings, expansions, and site reconfigurations — working with Facilities, Real Estate, and infrastructure partners to integrate manufacturing floor plans with building shell design, utility routing, dock placement, aisle widths, column spacing, and overhead clearance.

• Proactively identify spatial bottlenecks, material flow inefficiencies, and layout constraints caused by production rate changes, new product introductions, or facility limitations; flag constraints with the appropriate owners and

jobs.title: Director, Supplier Industrialization Engineering
jobs.desc:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. 

 Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. 

 About the Team: 

 The Reliability team at Relativity Space ensures quality is built into every stage of the Terran R design and production process, embedding reliability from the very beginning. The team works directly with design, manufacturing, test, and launch teams to stay close to the hardware, understand constraints, and proactively shape decisions. As the program moves from development into production and scaled operations, this is the time to establish the right processes, controls, and inspections without slowing progress. The team plays a key role in balancing risk, fostering a culture of ownership, and making sure speed never comes at the cost of reliability. Success means creating a quality system that scales with the Terran R program and Relativity as a whole. 

 About the Role: 

• Develop and lead a high-performing Supplier Development Engineering team, fostering ownership, technical rigor, and data-driven decision-making. 

• Set and execute the supplier development strategy, reliability roadmap, and SQMS processes to meet Terran R production, launch, and compliance requirements (AS9100/ISO 9001). 

• Drive supplier performance management, establishing key metrics and scorecards to improve PPM, yield, PPAP timing, and overall supplier capability. 

• Own major supplier risk escalation and resolution, guiding disciplined problem solving (e.g., 8D) and ensuring rapid recovery on quality or capacity issues. 

• Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain on supplier qualification, technical requirements, and NPI execution. 

• Oversee technical and operational execution, including supplier qualification, APQP/DFM/DFA, PPAP/FAIR approvals, and CI initiatives (Lean/Six Sigma) to ensure robust manufacturing and protect build schedules. 

 About You: 

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or a related technical field) 

• 10+ years of experience in Supplier Industrialization, Supplier Development, or Manufacturing Engineering, ideally within the aerospace or a high-reliability/safety-critical industry. 

• 5+ years of direct people management experience, including coaching, mentorship, and performance management of an engineering team 

• Expert knowledge of quality systems (AS9100/ISO 9001) and core quality tools (APQP, PPAP, FAIRs, PFMEA, Control Plans), with a proven ability to influence the implementation and compliance of key quality initiatives. 

• Demonstrated capability to build processes from the ground up and successfully deploy them across diverse teams. 

• Willingness to travel up to 50% of the work week when needed. 

 Nice to haves but not required: 

• Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or a related technical field). 

• Professional certification such as Six Sigma Black Belt, ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or PMP. 

• Familiarity with high-volume inspection methods and data-driven acceptance methods. 

• Strong knowledge of enterprise applications (i.e., PLM, ERP, MES) and proficient in data analysis.

 Northrop Grumman Undersea Systems in Annapolis, MD is currently seeking an experienced Principal or Sr. Principal PCB Layout Design Engineer to join the Hardware Engineering Team.  

 In this role, the Principal or Sr. Principal PCB Layout Design Engineer  will generate printed circuit board (PCB) stack-ups and layouts, draw and revise components, create bare printed wiring board (PWB) drawings, circuit card assembly (CCA) drawings, and establish references and standard data for PCB design artifacts. Utilizing computer-aided design (CAD) graphic tools such as Mentor Graphics Xpedition to complete details of critical layout data in accordance with standard engineering drafting practices, military specifications, as well as industry standards.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 • Layout components and route electrical conductors for complex PCB’s and flex circuits
• Interface with electrical and mechanical engineers to work through component placement, routing, mechanical fitment for rigid, flex, and rigid-flex assemblies
• Design to electrical requirements, mechanical outlines, for producibility and manufacturability
• Calculate layer stack-up based on industry standards, supplier capabilities, and engineering requirements
• Generate drawings for the bare PWB and assembled CCA levels, as well as their corresponding part lists
• Assist in component selection for PCB designs to reduce supply chain procurement risks.
• Create and document the required electronic data file outputs for fabrication and manufacturing
• Understand technical theories of electrical and mechanical behavior of PCBs to influence layout decisions (i.e. impedance matching, differential pairs, strains and stresses, orientation of components, etc.)
• Maintain and update CAD central libraries for PCB mounted components
• Address Technical Queries (TQs) with suppliers
• Perform reviews of PCB related documentation in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Workflows
• Generate and incorporate PCB engineering change notices.
• Collaborate with others to refine the PCB engineering workflow.

 This position can be filled at a Principal or Senior Principal level.

• Drafting and design experience of PCB layout and layer stack-up (analog, digital, RF, mixed signal topologies).
• Knowledge of industry specifications and design for manufacturing (DFM) rules for PCB design, fabrication and manufacturing.
• Knowledge of PCB design rules and techniques for PCBs with anywhere from 2-20 layers from initial prototype to production.
• Excellent interpersonal skills. Be able to coordinate and lead PCB design reviews with engineering, chief engineers, and program management.
• Ability to interface with various departments across a variety of programs.
• US Citizen with ability to obtain a US government secret security clearance.

jobs.title: Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE TEAM 

 The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

 ABOUT THE JOB 

 The Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling development and production flow of Anduril’s critical supply base. You will work in close coordination with internal engineering, quality, supply chain and manufacturing departments as well as directly with suppliers to execute effective, creative and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. 

We're looking for a talented Senior Supplier Industrialization Engineer to expedite the qualification and implementation of product designs with our suppliers, optimizing these designs for quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness from early development through the entire product lifecycle.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

• Own and manage the mechanical commodities/subcategories (machining, stamping, etc.) to execute supplier production (NPI to full production) strategies across Anduril’s business lines

• Be a force multiplier for the Supply Chain team and overall commodity strategy, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage

• Vet Suppliers' production capabilities, factory lay out, facilities, workforce for supplier inclusion in Anduril's Approved Supplier List

• Support Supplier Quality Engineers (SQE) in ensuring Suppliers' understanding and adherence to the criteria for part quality set by SQE

• Own manufacturing process development at Supplier locations & the initialization of new production lines & tooling at Supplier sites to ensure materials, processes, & tools are capable of meeting product performance, quality, and production rate requirements

• Own the roadmap for capacity expansion, manufacturing readiness, and production ramp-up at Suppliers

• Establish and drive performance via statistical process control (SPC) reviews at Supplier

• Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization at Supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate potential defects, and improve cycle time over the product lifecycle

• Support SQE with root cause task force at Anduril by working in tandem with the Supply Chain team, Suppliers, and be responsible for closing the loop of root cause corrective/preventative actions at Supplier

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field

• 6+ years of experience in supplier quality and industrialization within a manufacturing environment

• Experience with specific category technical expertise, as applicable, composites and thermoplastics manufacturing, IPC standards, CAD, GD&T

• Ability to travel at least 50% of the time

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Huntsville, AL

• Ability to be eligible and maintain a U.S. clearance

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or metallurgical/materials engineering, or related technical field

• Previous experience in defense, aerospace, automotive, high tech, or another related industry

• Strong understanding of quality systems, standards, and certifications

• Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment

• Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

 US Salary Range
 $113,000 — $149,000 USD 

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. • Lead electronics supplier industrialization for EW products from early PCBA builds through production ramp

• Identify and drive product and process improvements, factory layout optimization, and Value Engineering (VE) initiatives at supplier sites to lower part cost, reduce supply risk, eliminate defects, and improve cycle time

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
